# Team Specification

A team's file: its head (`[access]` among it), its roster and its
shared settings, the opinions
every member shares in `[settings.agent]`. The `team` specification is TOML, given to a command that reads it as a file, and a field flag sets the field it names, overriding the file. Its JSON Schema is [`team.schema.json`](team.schema.json).

## Use It

Give `lnk agent team create` a `team` specification as a file, and set any field below with its field flag, which overrides the file. `lnk agent team spec show` prints the specification as it is read.

## Every Option

Every field the reader takes, with an example value.

```toml
kind = "team"
schema = 1
id = "k3m4n5p6q7r8"
lead = "scout"
name = "research"
version = 1

[access]
member = ["service:k3m4n5p6q7r8"]

[files]
shared = "~/Link/Teams/research"

[member.reviewer]
id = "k3m4n5p6q7r8"
owner = "a1b2c3d4"
purpose = "Reviews drafts"
read = ["sources"]
service = "service:k3m4n5p6q7r8"
write = ["drafts"]

[member.scout]
purpose = "Finds sources"

[member.scout.agent.model]
thinking = "medium"

[settings.agent.window]
compact_at = 0.75

[settings.memory]
daily_credits = 100
semantic = true

[settings.memory.indexer]
kind = "auto"

[settings.memory.payer]
kind = "owner"
```

## `access`

> **Type** a table · **Flag** `--access`

A team file's `[access]`: which agents of other accounts may be on
it. It takes members alone, so an agent's `message` isn't one of its
keys.

### `member`

> **Type** a list, each text · **Flag** `--access.member`

Which agents of other accounts may be on the team, each the
service it acts as, `service:<agent id>`: the team owner's yes; the
agent's owner says the other, by joining.

## `files`

> **Type** a table · **Flag** `--files`

`[files]`: the folder the team's members share.

### `shared`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--files.shared`

The shared folder, from the home folder (`~/Link/Teams/research`).

## `id`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--id`

The team's permanent ID, which keeps it the same team through
renames, restarts and moves; left out, the first apply assigns it.

## `lead`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--lead`

The member a message addressed to the team reaches, by its name;
left out, the team takes none until you name one.

## `member`

> **Type** a table by name, each a table · **Flag** `--member`

Its members, by their names in the team: each an existing agent by
its ID, or an agent definition the team makes and manages.

### `<name>`

> **Type** a table · **Flag** `--member.<name>`

A team's member, by its name in the file.

#### `agent`

> **Type** a table · **Flag** `--member.<name>.agent`

An agent, written down: the file `lnk agent start --spec` reads and
`lnk agent spec show` prints.

Its fields are the [Agent Specification](agent.md)'s, each a key below this one.

#### `id`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.id`

The agent's ID.

#### `owner`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.owner`

Its account, for another account's agent, which the team's
`[access] member` names: none, the team owner's own.

#### `purpose`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.purpose`

What it's for on the team, for people and its teammates.

#### `read`

> **Type** a list, each text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.read`

For another account's agent, the folders of the team's folder it
may only read.

#### `service`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.service`

The service the agent acts as, written service:<id>: the role holder
a teammate's check names. An own agent's is read from its settings
as the team is loaded; another account's is named in the file.

#### `write`

> **Type** a list, each text · **Flag** `--member.<name>.write`

For another account's agent, the folders of the team's folder it
may write, and those it may only read, as `[teams.<team>]`
names them: the most it reaches, the team owner's to say. An own
agent's are in its sandbox file.

## `name`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--spec.name`

The team's name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

## `settings`

> **Type** a table · **Default** `{}` · **Flag** `--settings`

### `agent`

> **Type** a table · **Default** `{}` · **Flag** `--settings.agent`

An agent, written down: the file `lnk agent start --spec` reads and
`lnk agent spec show` prints.

Its fields are the [Agent Specification](agent.md)'s, each a key below this one.

### `memory`

> **Type** a table · **Default** `{}` · **Flag** `--settings.memory`

A team's memory: one memory over its shared folder, handed to the members granted all of it

#### `daily_credits`

> **Type** a whole number from 0 · **Flag** `--settings.memory.daily_credits`

Shared daily memory spending in credits; required when enabling
semantic search. All callers debit the same team budget.

#### `enabled`

> **Type** `true` or `false` · **Default** `false` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.enabled`

Whether the team has a memory over its shared folder, handed to the
members granted all of it: off until the owner turns it on (`lnk agent
team-memory start`).

#### `indexer`

> **Type** a table · **Default** `{ kind = "auto" }` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.indexer`

One eligible whole-folder writer, elected outside the runtime.

##### `settings.memory.indexer.kind`

> **Type** one of `auto`, `member` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.indexer.kind`

Which keeper it is: auto, elected, or a named member.

##### `settings.memory.indexer.member`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--settings.memory.indexer.member`

The member, by its name in the team's file.

#### `payer`

> **Type** a table · **Default** `{ kind = "owner" }` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.payer`

The team's owner.

##### `settings.memory.payer.kind`

> **Type** one of `owner`, `member` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.payer.kind`

Who pays: the team's owner, or a named member.

##### `settings.memory.payer.member`

> **Type** text · **Flag** `--settings.memory.payer.member`

The member, by its name in the team's file.

#### `semantic`

> **Type** `true` or `false` · **Default** `false` · **Flag** `--settings.memory.semantic`

Non-indexers use words until the owner enables semantic queries.

## `version`

> **Type** a whole number from 0 · **Flag** `--spec.version`

A whole number of yours, to say which revision of the file this
is; Link reads nothing from it.
